title: Sympathy for the Devil: The Apprentice (2024)

commenti.body: Fiction and films are at their best when they don't settle for simple moral duality and test our sympathies. Think of every movie you've ever loved and I bet the behavior of the characters is morally grey; it's more realistically human.

I saw this a couple nights ago and I think it was really good. For reference: I am a political activist for the Democrats in my area and feminism in general, but I am not someone who really enjoys the many ways leftists tend to laugh at Trump. I find him dangerous and despicable, but I don’t
think living off Diet Coke and cheeseburgers is a joke or a sin. 
    
Growing up in NJ in the 90’s, I was familiar with Atlantic City, and with the mythos of Trump back then. This movie was exactly what I expected it to be, and I don’t think the compassion the early movie treats young Donald with is out of step with the politics overall. If anything, I think it shows that the selfish fascist he has become was not inevitable. The man in the movie made decisions that hurt the people closest to him because it was easy and he liked getting away with it. I can’t speak to Trump’s character irl, but that’s what the movie showed. 
    
There was clearly one couple in the theater who didn’t know what the movie was really about, and they guffawed all through the first half, talking loudly between themselves. But they quieted down about the part where Freddy showed up at the apartment, and after the rape scene, they didn’t make a fucking peep. I’m glad they watched this movie, Vote blue and vote early if you can.
''talking loudly between themselves''    Ugh, no one should ever have to put up with that shit in a movie theater.

What I got from the film when it comes to feeling sympathy for the characters is no matter how despicable you are, there is someone in your life you deeply care for, I may be wrong. However, knowing Trump felt pain and sadness from his brother's death and Cohn's from his lover's death, show that they are human despite their character.

"As a morally pure and perfect individual..." Has got to be the most unintentionally funny start to an unironic post I have ever seen lmao. I don’t know how anyone can take the rest of such a post seriously. Holy shit OP, get over yourself. I’m sure you’re free of faults. Thank you for enlightening us, oh holy one.
